question: Can accomplishment arise for someone lacking the required qualifications?
premises: Accomplishment is denied even from afar.
This denial applies to the other person.
The best of the twice-born is addressed.
inference: For one without the required qualifications, accomplishment does not arise at all.
uncertainties: The identity of itarasya is inferred from contrast with prior verses.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, for the other person accomplishment would not arise, even from afar.
